requirement.text: The system shall notify customers of changes to its information policy.

initial_eus.title: Notification of Information Policy Changes
initial_eus.description: As a customer, I want to be notified of changes to the system's information policy, so that I am aware of how the policy governing my information has changed.
work_items: The system notifies customers when its information policy changes.

analysis.ethical_objective: Transparency toward customers regarding how the system's information policy changes, so customers remain informed about how their information is handled.

obligations.text: The system shall notify customers when its information policy changes.
obligations.source_span: The system shall notify customers of changes to its information policy.

constraints: Applies when the system's information policy changes.
ambiguities: The source does not define what constitutes the 'information policy' (e.g., privacy policy, data handling policy, terms of information use).
The source does not specify which changes qualify (all changes vs. material changes).
The source does not specify the timing of notification (before or after the change takes effect).
The source does not specify the notification channel, form, or content.
The source does not specify whether customers must acknowledge or consent to the change.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume notification must occur in advance of the change or within a specific timeframe.
Do not assume a particular notification channel (e.g., email, in-app message).
Do not assume that only material or significant changes require notification.
Do not assume customer acknowledgment or consent is required.
Do not assume the notification must summarize or explain the specific changes in a particular way.
Do not assume applicability to any legal or regulatory framework.
possible_operational_aspects: Triggered by a change to the system's information policy.
Notification is delivered to customers as the recipient group.

work_items.explanation: The work item states that the system notifies customers when its information policy changes, which directly expresses obligation O1 without adding timing, channel, content, or acknowledgment conditions beyond the source.
